'''Naast Squad''' was an elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit, and was part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="o66" />

About 3 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the squad consisted mostly of [[Cuy'val Dar]] [[Rav Bralor]]'s trainees.<ref name="o66" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'' {{1st}}
